notes.title: Update - Colorblind Patch
notes.content:
After many requests, You Don't Have Time now has an option for those who are color blind who couldn't properly play the Simon riddle.
You can activate it in the settings from the main menu!

An option to reverse the vertical axis of the mouse has also been added.
This can be activated at any time from the keys menu.

notes.title: Update - Extra time in room 08
notes.content:
The update that many have been waiting for!

Room 08 has been modified, you now have more time to click on the button, and the code is displayed on the screen longer.

notes.title: Update - New language supported and patch
notes.content:
First update of You Don't Have Time!

[list]
[*] Spanish has been added to the game, you can choose it in the settings.
[*] The text of clues on the screens has been enlarged to see it better on your screen
[*] The display duration of some clues has been increased
[*] Some rooms has been improved to help you solve them more easily
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
